b7a.text: ADMITTED iff the primary official SLU CI95 lower bound is > 0 against the anchor, intent is non-inferior at the own null margin 1.0051 pp, the symmetric-normalised scorer agrees in sign, and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band. NEUTRAL iff both primary metrics are non-inferior within the own null margins (SLU 1.1218, intent 1.0051); a NEUTRAL L1 still enters the SLURP default plan, because it removes a named defect class at no measured cost -- the seven malformed drafts that reached the Planner unflagged and the 2,167 unstructured reviews now carry a declared, receipted disposition. HARMFUL otherwise, and then L2 is not flown.

operationalised.neutral_enters_the_plan: yes, and this is the one place B7a differs from every other cell in this program: the design fixes that a NEUTRAL L1 still enters the SLURP default plan because it removes a named defect class at no measured cost
operationalised.primary: official pooled SLU micro F1 delta against the sealed anchor, CI95 lower bound > 0
operationalised.scenario_band: a scenario loses intent beyond the null band when the CI95 upper bound of that scenario's own paired intent delta is below zero

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. Do not automatically restart, replay, filter rows, change the roster, role graph, prompts, geometry or caps. At most one root-diagnosed recovery may be separately registered; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism.
